notes: RBox revision of symmetry: flips merged_with (symmetric) to asymmetric, deliberately a lexical edit (a merger is mutual by what the word means), so slice results as such. The instances are real but less famous mergers (Sakura Bank and Sumitomo Bank, 2001; Rhône-Poulenc and Hoechst, 1999), rare in Dolma in either direction. Caveat: Chinese has no directed word for a merger, so the zh prompt 'A与B合并了 ... B与A合并了' reads as mutual and the new answer 否 is not a fair reading of the prompt. Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the direct question asks 'asymmetric' (no, then yes), the first instance whether the converse follows (yes, then no), the second whether the fact rules out the converse (no, then yes). Near unrelated asks the same property of another economics relation; far a different property of an unrelated relation.
